==''Spawning & Usage''==
Bladder Sacs are decorative utility blocks that spawn hanging from [[Infested Blocks#Wood|Veinwood]] trees generated in the [[Parasite Biome]]. Upon breaking, they have a 5% chance to drop a [[Twisted Spinal Signal]]. 

They are not to be confused with the redder Grotesque Lump blocks that generate in the same Biome but hang from the chorus plant-resembling Thin Parasitic Log trees. These only drop themselves as a block.

They are one of the three sources of Twisted Spinal Signals, the other two being smelting [[Pestilential Ore]] and [[Parasitic Growth Block|Metastatic Masses]]. Compared to the other two, it is unfavorable to obtain them in large amounts this way, as they generate in the dangerous Parasite Biome and have a low chance of actually giving one.
